verdict.rationale: LangGraph exposes a comprehensively documented programmatic API (graph construction, streaming modes, interrupts, checkpointers, stores) across many docs pages, plus a CLI (`langgraph dev`, `langgraph deploy`) that stands up an Agent Server, and community confirms it's genuinely programmable/extensible (nodes as arbitrary functions, custom tool handling). Missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/REST spec for the deployed Agent Server (probe found 404s on openapi.json endpoints) and stronger independent confirmation of the deployed server's API docs.
